citation.authors: Chang C-K, Huang C-Y, Lin Y-H, et al.
citation.title: Acute mangosteen-based juice supplementation and exhaustive cycle ergometer exercise: placebo-controlled crossover trial
citation.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

reported.what: Cycling bout set as a work rate of 60% of VO2max for 30 min, then 15 W steps every 2 min to exhaustion; the paper prints no VO2max, no watts and no VO2 for the group (VO2max was predicted per person by the Astrand protocol, no group value printed)

location.quote: each participant performed with a relative work rate of 60 % of VO2max on the same cycle ergometer for 30 min

reported.what: Placebo-arm blood glucose (mg/dL, mean (SD), n=12) before and during the bout: Pre-Ex, Ex-15, Ex-30, Post-Ex
Placebo-arm blood lactate (mmol/L, mean (SD), n=12) at the same times
Placebo-arm serum cortisol (ug/dL, mean (SD), n=12) at the same times

detail: The bout is only '60% of VO2max' with no group VO2max (or watts) printed and its duration to exhaustion is in a figure, and the placebo juice (fruit concentrates) is given 1 h before exercise with no carbohydrate grams, so even the Pre-Ex values are not a fasted sample the model can run.
